title: IPFS first-party A2UI catalog negotiation
description: Additive AG-UI capability branch and inert result fallback. Canonical tuple and view bindings live only in derivations/a2ui-components.json; see agentic/ui-negotiation.md.

CatalogOffer.description: Capability offer only; exact tuple must match derivations/a2ui-components.json. Identifier is never fetched. Unsupported well-formed versions are not negotiated.

ClientA2UICapabilities.description: Value of RunAgentInput.forwardedProps.ipfs.a2ui. Max encoded namespace 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Invalid/missing/oversize namespace disables A2UI only; never forwards arbitrary client data or enables model-composed HTML.

CatalogAdvertisement.description: a2ui.catalog CUSTOM event value. Exact supported tuple and configured same-listener route; no arbitrary catalog URL fetching.

IframeException.description: Value of resource _meta['ai.ipfs/iframe-exception']; a declaration only, ignored safely by ordinary hosts. Does not replace _meta.ui, grant permissions or require a private field in messages.

InertResult.description: Safe plain-text fallback; unknown/invalid structured data is not partly rendered. No markup/link/action props. Copy text is the only control. Render text nodes, never HTML/Markdown/autolinks, and do not execute/fetch/navigate.
